records.title: ClusterFusion++: Expanding Cluster-Level Fusion to Full Transformer-Block Decoding
records.reason: ClusterFusion++ fuses a full Transformer decoder block (LayerNorm, QKV, RoPE, decode attention, MLP) into cluster-level CUDA kernels with CUDA-Graph execution, cutting decoding latency on Pythia models; a direct LLM decoding kernel contribution.

records.title: Learning-Based Collaborative MEC for LLM Inference with Soft-Deadline Awareness via Transformer-Enhanced PPO
records.reason: Proposes Transformer-enhanced PPO collaboration among MEC servers that schedules LLM inference tasks under soft deadlines with limited deadline extensions; the contribution targets LLM inference scheduling and QoS at the edge.

records.title: Total Cost of Agency: Exact Attribution of Memory Injection Cost in Multi-Agent LLM Workflows
records.reason: Total Cost of Agency only decomposes and attributes memory-injection token costs in multi-agent LLM workflows for observability; it measures inference cost but proposes no serving, memory, or decoding optimization.

records.title: Distributed Inference of Large Language Models on Edge Devices
records.reason: Presents a distributed architecture that runs LLM inference across local-network edge devices (mobile phones) and reports up to 74% lower per-token inference time at four nodes; direct distributed edge inference contribution.

records.title: Can persistent homology whiten Transformer-based black-box models? A case study on BERT compression
records.reason: OBCE uses persistent homology of neuron outputs to rank and remove BERT parameters, compressing BERT Base/Large by roughly half for deployment on resource-constrained devices; a model compression method aimed at cheaper inference.

records.title: Revisiting Funnel Transformers for Modern LLM Architectures with Comprehensive Ablations in Training and Inference Configurations
records.reason: Re-evaluates Funnel Transformer representation compression in Gemma2 with training and inference configuration ablations; mainly an architecture study showing funneling bottlenecks, not a deployable inference system technique.

records.title: GPEmu: A GPU Emulator for Faster and Cheaper Prototyping and Evaluation of Deep Learning System Research
records.reason: GPEmu emulates GPUs (time, memory, distributed and sharing support) to prototype deep learning systems research without real GPUs; a useful systems-research tool but not specific to LLM inference serving or execution.

records.title: ReTern: Exploiting Natural Redundancy and Sign Transformations for Enhanced Fault Tolerance in Compute-in-Memory-Based Ternary LLMs
records.reason: ReTern improves fault tolerance of ternary LLMs deployed on compute-in-memory accelerators via fault-aware sign transformations and bit-cell reprogramming; hardware-level work for efficient ternary LLM inference.

records.title: Native Reasoning Models: Training Language Models to Reason on Unverifiable Data
records.reason: Native Reasoning Training trains language models to reason on unverifiable data with self-generated traces; a training paradigm for reasoning capability with no inference-system mechanism or efficiency contribution.

records.title: Obscura: Concealing Recomputation Overhead in Training of Large Language Models with Bubble-filling Pipeline Transformation
records.reason: Obscura hides activation-recomputation overhead inside pipeline-parallel bubbles to speed up LLM training throughput on Llama-2/GPT-3; training-only acceleration with no inference application stated.

records.title: SwFormer: Enabling Faster Foundation Models on New Sunway Supercomputer via Holistic Kernel Tiling and Scheduling
records.reason: SwFormer accelerates foundation models on the Sunway supercomputer via intra-op kernel tiling and inter-op scheduling, but evaluation is end-to-end GPT-3 training speedups; inference benefit is not demonstrated in the abstract.

records.title: UCCI: Calibrated Uncertainty for Cost-Optimal LLM Cascade Routing
records.reason: UCCI is a calibration-first LLM cascade router that maps token-level margin uncertainty to per-query error probability and picks escalation thresholds by constrained inference-cost minimization on a production workload; direct inference cost optimization.

records.title: Conformal LLM Routing with Distribution-Free Safety Guarantees
records.reason: Adapts conformal gating to LLM routing between Mixtral-8x7B and GPT-4 with a guaranteed violation rate among queries sent to the cheaper model; a routing method whose explicit objective is reducing inference cost safely.

records.title: DLLM-Searcher: Adapting Diffusion Language Model for Efficient Search Agents
records.reason: DLLM-Searcher adapts diffusion LLMs' parallel decoding to ReAct search agents, but the primary aim is restoring agent reasoning and tool-calling ability; the inference-efficiency gain is secondary to the agent application.

records.title: Adaptive Scheduling of Multimodal Large Language Model in Intelligent Edge Computing
records.reason: Decouples MLLM encoders from the LLM across heterogeneous edge devices and adaptively schedules multimodal inference to cut transmission latency and privacy risk; direct edge inference scheduling for MLLMs.

records.title: Asteria: Semantic-Aware Cross-Region Caching for Agentic LLM Tool Access
records.reason: Asteria/Cortex is a cross-region semantic caching architecture for LLM agent tool access, with semantic elements and a retrieval index carrying latency and cost metadata; a caching system reducing LLM workflow latency and cost.

records.title: Efficient Algorithms for Leveraging LLMs for Generative and Predictive Recommender Systems
records.reason: A tutorial on LLM optimizations (quantization, pruning, GPU kernels) for LinkedIn recommender systems; the main purpose is the recommender application and the format is a tutorial, so the inference-system contribution is indirect.

records.title: Dora: QoE-Aware Hybrid Parallelism for Distributed Edge AI
records.reason: Dora plans QoE-aware hybrid (data and pipeline) parallelism for distributed edge AI inference under runtime dynamics and latency requirements; direct distributed inference execution planning.

records.title: Differentially Private Model Compression
records.reason: Initiates differentially private model compression and reaches 50% sparsity on BERT, but the novelty centers on privacy guarantees during fine-tuning rather than an inference execution or serving mechanism.

records.title: Enabling Real-Time AI at the Edge: A Comparative Analysis of Latency and Accuracy in Sub-3B Parameter Models
records.reason: Comparative measurement of three 4-bit GGUF small models under llama.cpp in a simulated mobile setting (latency versus reasoning trade-offs); an evaluation study with no new inference technique.
